properties.evidence: identity.rs identity_path() (main f46bd3065, about line 88) builds `<parent>/<file_name>.id.json` from the --graph-path string with no canonicalisation. Measured on all three binaries: a write through the symlink stores/bq -> proj/.reflow2/graph left bq.id.json beside the link and nothing beside the store, and an open by proj/.reflow2/graph was refused as lost identity. Copying bq.id.json to proj/.reflow2/graph.id.json made the same open succeed and read the node.
